company.name: Allowance
company.shortDescription: Allowance is an online market place where college students can complete task based jobs for homeowners to help pay off student loan debt.
company.description: Allowance is a freelance app service that creates an online marketplace connecting working professionals (Patrons) with college students (Students) through the trade of services. With our service, Patrons will post non-licensed/non-contracted jobs and students will have the ability to complete these tasks while being provided an alternative income source by completing these chores posted by the Patron. With a better way to earn money and the utilization of financial technology, Allowance helps students alleviate the financial burden of obtaining a college education.
